note: The states of a run, written once. tests/test_run_history.py checks the runner's Status type; editor/tests/round10.test.ts checks the editor has a text for each in every language. waits: counted as 'waits for you' (unless older than a day or dismissed). holds: keeps a queued run from starting.

gate.means: stopped at a human gate (or a stop gate's end)

paused.means: a step-by-step test between two steps

decided.means: decided at its gate while another run went; goes on next, kept on disk

held.means: the person is changing the recorded decision
